script: I poured baby shampoo into my eyes—now I feel like napalm.. When my little dude was four, he started whining in the tub that the shampoo was "stabbing" his eyes. I was like, "Bruh, baby shampoo is tear‑free, you're just acting." He kept insisting. I was already losing my patience, so I grabbed the bottle and said, "Look." Then I poured a splash right into my own eyes. OH MY GOD. It burned. Like a mix of lemon juice, napalm, and pepper spray, but on my eyeballs. I didn't know if it was a bad bottle or just a crappy brand, but it absolutely hurt. After rinsing my eyes, I shifted focus to him. I thought about how he must've felt when his daddy said it wouldn't hurt and then it did. I imagined the embarrassment and the disappointment in his tiny face. I knew he'd felt let down when I didn't believe him. So yeah, the "no‑tear" claim was a lie. I got a taste of it myself, and it was a painful lesson for both of us.
